pages.notImplemented: This page is still being built and will arrive in a later version.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has been removed.

login.title: Sign in
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

errors.unauthorized: You are not signed in, or your session has expired.
errors.csrf_invalid: Your session token is out of date. Reload the page.
errors.network_error: Can't reach the server. Make sure notesteme serve is running, then retry.
errors.unrecognized_url: This URL isn't recognized. YouTube, Bilibili, podcast RSS and local files are supported.
errors.unsupported_scheme: Only http and https URLs are supported.
errors.blocked_address: This URL points to a private or local address, so it won't be fetched for security reasons.
errors.too_many_redirects: This URL redirects too many times.
errors.response_too_large: The content at this URL is too large to check.
errors.channel_not_ingestable: This is a channel. To follow new content, create a subscription.
errors.in_trash: This item is in the trash. Restore it to use it again.
errors.upstream_failed: The platform didn't respond (for example, yt-dlp failed). Try again later, and update yt-dlp if it keeps failing.
errors.upload_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
errors.unsupported_media: This file has no audio or video that can be read.
errors.too_many_uploads: Another upload is in progress. Try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.cookie_unsupported_platform: Only YouTube and Bilibili cookies are supported.
errors.cookie_empty: The cookie is empty. Paste the cookie contents or choose a cookie file.
errors.cookie_too_large: The cookie is larger than 64 KiB. Export only this platform's cookies and try again.
errors.cookie_no_match: No cookies for this platform's domain were found. Make sure you exported youtube.com or bilibili.com cookies in Netscape or name=value format.
errors.cookie_missing_sessdata: The Bilibili cookie is missing SESSDATA. Sign in to Bilibili and export the cookies again.
errors.cookie_invalid_format: A cookie name or value contains control characters (such as a newline or tab). Export the cookies again and try once more.
errors.token_exists: An active token with this name already exists. Choose another name or revoke the old one first.
errors.style_exists: A style with this name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.builtin_style: Built-in styles can't be changed. Copy it to a custom style first.
errors.prompt_exists: A prompt with this ID already exists. Choose another ID.
errors.builtin_prompt: Built-in prompts can't be changed. Save it as a new prompt first.
errors.builtin_profile: The built-in default preset can't be deleted.
errors.no_agent_tasks: This step has no waiting Agent task to switch.
errors.api_not_configured: No API provider is set for this step. Add one in settings first.
errors.no_media: There is no local media to play for this item.
errors.media_missing: The local file is no longer where it was.
errors.not_implemented: This feature is not available yet.

library.attentionNoMessage: {{stage}}: {{reason}}. Open the item to see its log.
library.empty: No media yet. Paste a YouTube, Bilibili or podcast URL, or pick a video file.
library.staleList: The connection dropped, so this list may be out of date. Reload

filters.searchHint: Press / to focus, Esc to clear
filters.channelHint: Channel ID, or click a channel in the list
filters.stageStatusHint: Within a step, any checked status matches; across steps, all must match.

add.title: Add
add.description: Paste a URL or pick a local file. Notesteme gets the subtitles and processes them with your preset.
add.urlHint: A YouTube video or playlist, a Bilibili video, or a podcast RSS feed
add.needInput: Paste a URL or pick a file.
add.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL that starts with http or https.
add.playlistWhole: Every video in the playlist will be added. Videos already in your library are not added again.
add.channelHint: This is a channel. To follow new content, create a subscription (coming in a later version).
add.requiresCookie: This video needs a signed-in account. Upload a cookie first.
add.partsInvalid: Part numbers look wrong. For example: 1, 3, 5-7.
add.profilesUnavailable: Couldn't load presets. The default preset will be used.
add.startedWithExisting_other: Started processing {{count}} items; {{existing}} already in your library
add.startedWithExisting_one: Started processing {{count}} item; {{existing}} already in your library
add.alreadyInLibrary_other: Already in your library ({{count}} items), so nothing was added.
add.alreadyInLibrary_one: Already in your library, so nothing was added.

entry.invalidUrl: The address from the bookmarklet or share was not valid and was ignored.
entry.noUrl: The shared content has no web address.

actions.republish: Publish again after fixing the file
actions.openPrompt: Pick a prompt and process again

item.notFound: This item was not found. It may have been deleted.

actions.ytdlpRolledBack: The new yt-dlp failed its self-check and was rolled back to {{version}}.

player.mediaUnavailable: This file can't be played: it may have moved, or the browser doesn't support its format. You can still read the subtitles.
player.reloadFallback: The player isn't responding; clicking a line reloads it at that time.

cues.title: Subtitles
cues.empty: This version has no subtitles yet.
cues.notYet: No subtitles yet. They appear here when the subtitle step finishes.

rerun.title: Process again
rerun.description: This creates a new version and keeps the old one, so you can compare them under Changes.
rerun.providerHint: Leave empty to use the profile's setting.
rerun.chunksHint: Numbers start at 1, e.g. 2, 5-7. Leave empty to rerun all; other chunks reuse the cache.
rerun.noEstimate: Cost estimate: not available for reruns yet.

cancel.title: Stop processing this item?
cancel.description: Every unfinished step of this item stops and is marked as skipped; running programs are ended. Finished outputs are kept and you can process again later.

cookie.title: Upload {{platform}} cookies
cookie.description: A Netscape cookie file exported by a browser extension, or a name=value; … header. Cookies are stored encrypted; waiting steps resume after upload.
cookie.tooLarge: The file is over 64 KiB. Export only this platform's cookies.
cookie.unsupported: Only YouTube and Bilibili use cookies.

delete.title: Move to trash?
delete.description: “{{title}}” moves to the trash. You can restore it until the retention period ends.
delete.restoreHint: Until it's permanently deleted, restoring it brings everything back.
delete.deleteOutputs_one: Also delete the unmodified output file ({{formatted}})
delete.deleteOutputs_other: Also delete the unmodified output files ({{formatted}})
delete.deleteOutputsHint: If you restore the item, these files are written back.
delete.doneKept_one: Moved to trash. Kept {{formatted}} modified output file.
delete.doneKept_other: Moved to trash. Kept {{formatted}} modified output files.

outputs.none: No files written yet. Files appear here when the profile has a sidecar or folder output.

import.title: Import edited subtitles
import.description: An SRT, VTT or ASS file edited elsewhere becomes a new Edited version. Existing translations are marked as possibly outdated and aren't redone automatically.
import.tooLarge: The file is too large (10 MB max).
import.doneStale_one: Imported {{count}} line. The existing translation may be outdated.
import.doneStale_other: Imported {{count}} lines. The existing translation may be outdated.

queue.pausedBanner: The queue is paused. New tasks won't start.
queue.attentionNone: Nothing has failed or is stuck.
queue.attentionUnavailable: Couldn't count the items that need action.
queue.agentNote: Only tasks notesteme runs itself are listed here. See an item's Steps for tasks handed to an Agent.
queue.taskActionsNote: Single tasks can't be retried, cancelled or reprioritized yet. Stop processing stops every unfinished step of that item.
queue.empty: The queue is empty. Add something, or wait for new content from subscriptions.
queue.stopItemDescription: Every unfinished step of {{item}} stops and is marked as skipped, not just this task. Finished outputs are kept.

common.fieldErrors: Some fields are invalid. Nothing was saved:

services.keysHint: API keys are stored encrypted. After saving, only the last four characters are shown; you can replace or clear a key but never view it again.
services.keyFieldHint: The field is cleared after saving; only the last four characters are shown.
services.clearBody: Steps that use {{name}} will fail until you set a new key. The key can't be recovered, so make sure you have a copy.
services.testUnavailable: Test connection and model deprecation notices: the backend doesn't provide an API for these yet.

supadata.auto: Automatic (use platform captions if any, otherwise generate with Supadata)

services.commandHint: Command providers run commands on the host, so they can only be defined in the config file. They can't be added or changed here.

accounts.intro: Some videos require sign-in to download or to get captions. Uploaded cookies are stored encrypted, one per platform; a new upload replaces the old one. Media waiting for a cookie continues after saving.
accounts.title: {{name}} cookie
accounts.formatHint: A Netscape cookie file, or a browser header in name=value; … form (up to 64 KiB). Only cookies for this platform's domain are kept.
accounts.statusUnavailable: Last successful use and expiry status: the backend doesn't provide an API to read cookie status yet.

language.targetsHint: BCP-47 language tags separated by commas, for example zh-Hant-TW, en. At least one.
language.priorityHint: Platform caption tracks are checked in this order and the first match is used. Use original for the media's original language.
language.fallback: When no platform caption matches, use
language.fallbackHint: Tried in order, separated by commas, for example supadata, groq.
language.uiHint: Only affects the interface in this browser; separate from subtitle target languages. You can also switch it at the bottom of the navigation.

outputs.localTitle: Next to local videos and folders
outputs.localBody: Where subtitles are written is set in each preset (outputs): every preset can have its own targets, formats and languages.
outputs.sidecarBody: Written next to the local video file, with the same name.
outputs.folderBody: Written to the folder set in the preset; it must be inside the roots allowed in the config file.
outputs.vaultBody: The vault (local folder or git repo, branch, and what to do when you edited a file) can only be defined in the config file and is shown read-only here.
outputs.hookBody: Hooks can only be defined in the config file; presets can only pick defined ones.

agent.tokensHint: For MCP clients such as Claude Code, agents and scripts. A token is shown only once, when it's created.
agent.noTokens: No tokens yet. Create one for Claude Code.
agent.revokeBody: Programs using this token lose access immediately.
agent.name: Name
agent.nameHint: For example claude-code. Names must be unique among active tokens.

scope.read: Read the library, subtitles and settings objects

agent.createdBody: This token is shown only once. Copy it and keep it somewhere safe now; you can't view it after closing.
agent.snippetHint: Run this command in a terminal, replacing <token> with the token you created.
agent.agentHint: How agents claim tasks and what happens when they time out. Empty fields use the built-in defaults.
agent.timeout: Time limit for waiting on an agent
agent.onTimeout: When the time limit is reached
agent.onValidation: When an agent's results keep failing validation

glossary.globalHint: Proper nouns given to the model when correcting. Used for all media.
glossary.channelHint: Used only for this channel's media, together with the global glossary.
glossary.channelFormat: The channel UUID, or platform:channel ID, for example youtube:UCxxxxxxxx.
glossary.termsHint_one: {{count}} term; up to 500 terms of up to 100 characters each. Case-insensitive duplicates keep only the first.
glossary.termsHint_other: {{count}} terms; up to 500 terms of up to 100 characters each. Case-insensitive duplicates keep only the first.
glossary.candidatesHint: Terms the model suggested while correcting, waiting for your approval. Accepted terms are added to this channel's glossary; nothing is added automatically.
glossary.noCandidates: No term candidates are waiting for approval.
glossary.accepted: Accepted {{term}} and added it to the channel glossary
glossary.alreadyDecided: “{{term}}” was already handled (maybe in another tab, the CLI or MCP). The list has been refreshed.

system.versionsUnavailable: Versions: the backend doesn't report them yet; the new version is shown after updating yt-dlp.
system.ytdlpHint: yt-dlp often needs updating when platforms change. After updating it runs a self-check and rolls back automatically if that fails.
system.updateFailed: The self-check failed after updating; rolled back to {{version}}: {{reason}}
system.diskUnavailable: Disk usage: the backend doesn't report it yet (disk usage alerts are M4).
system.retentionUnavailable: Media file retention: the backend doesn't provide it yet. Trash retention is set with library.trash_retention_days in the config file.

config.exportHint: Export presets and the default preset as YAML to keep in version control or move to another machine. The built-in default preset and all API keys, cookies, tokens and passwords are not included.
config.exportedNone: There are no custom presets; the file only contains defaults.
config.importHint: Import YAML created by Export settings. The whole file is validated first; if anything is wrong, nothing is applied and every invalid field is listed.
config.confirmBody: Presets with the same name are replaced (a new version is created and old versions are kept); presets not in the file are not deleted; the default preset changes if the file sets one. There's no preview — the changes are listed after importing.

appearance.themeHint: Saved in this browser. You can also switch it at the bottom of the navigation.
appearance.densityUnavailable: Not available yet: the design spec doesn't define interface density.

login.passwordHint: After changing it, other devices and browsers are signed out immediately; this browser stays signed in.
login.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out
login.wrongCurrent: The current password is incorrect. Check it and try again; 5 wrong attempts in a row lock sign-in for 1 minute.
login.sessionsTitle: Sign-in sessions, reverse proxy authentication and OIDC

bookmarklet.title: Bookmarklet
bookmarklet.description: Drag the link below to your browser's bookmarks bar. Click it while watching a video and Notesteme opens Add in a new tab with the page's address filled in; nothing is processed until you press Start.
bookmarklet.codeHint: It only reads the current page's address and opens a new tab. It contains no credentials and does not read the page.
bookmarklet.mobile: Android: install Notesteme as an app (Install or Add to Home screen in the browser menu), then send links to it from any app's Share menu. iOS: use the Shortcuts app to open the address below, replacing {url} with the link to add.

itemPicker.none: No matching media. Try another keyword, or add media in the library first.

prompts.lead: Proofreading relies only on the LLM, so prompts are where results improve. Saving a new version doesn't change presets that use it until you set it as default.
prompts.newDescription: Choose an ID and type, then write the text on the edit page.
prompts.saveAsNewDescription: Creates a new prompt of the same type from the text in the editor. The original prompt stays unchanged.
prompts.idRule: Lowercase letters, digits, “.” and “-”, up to 64 characters; can't match a built-in ID.
prompts.newBodyPlaceholder: Write the instructions for the model here. You can use variables such as {{example}}.
prompts.builtinReadOnly: Built-in prompts can't be changed. To adjust it, save it as a new prompt.
prompts.unsavedHint: Unsaved changes (based on v{{version}}). Save a new version before setting it as default or trying it.
prompts.notDefaultHint: Viewing v{{version}}; presets currently use v{{current}}. Set as default to switch to this version.
prompts.versionHint: After editing, save a new version. Presets using this prompt won't switch automatically.
prompts.undefinedOnSave: Undefined variables: {{names}}. Use the available variables, then save again.

issue.invalid: “{{text}}” isn't a valid variable; names can only use letters, digits and underscores.

prompts.discardBody: Switching to v{{version}} discards the changes you haven't saved.
prompts.deleteBody_one: This permanently deletes the prompt and its {{count}} version. It can't be undone. Subtitles already produced and their source records are kept.
prompts.deleteBody_other: This permanently deletes the prompt and its {{count}} versions. It can't be undone. Subtitles already produced and their source records are kept.
prompts.inUse: This prompt is still in use, so it wasn't deleted:
prompts.inUseNext: Switch them to another prompt first, then delete it.
prompts.compareWithOutputs: Also try both versions on the same lines
prompts.compareCost: Runs twice, so it costs twice as much as one try.

run.title: Try it
run.rangeHint: MM:SS or HH:MM:SS; sends lines that start in the range, up to 200 lines.
run.usesSaved: Tries the saved v{{version}}, without your unsaved changes.
run.noWrite: Trying doesn't write any output or change step status.
run.estimateBefore: Cost can't be estimated beforehand; usage is shown after the run.
run.fillAll: Choose media and fill in the range, provider and model to try it.
run.validationFailed: Validation failed: some chunks ran out of retries and show the fallback text.
run.noEstimate: Cost unknown: the price table has no price for this model.
run.notSupported: This type of prompt can't be tried yet ({{reason}}).
run.rateLimited: Over the model's rate limit. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

profiles.lead: Save a set of processing settings as a reusable preset. Empty fields use the global settings.
profiles.newDescription: A new preset starts empty and uses the global settings; adjust it after creating.
profiles.copyDescription: Creates a new preset from the saved settings (unsaved changes aren't included).
profiles.name: Name
profiles.nameRule: Lowercase letters, digits, “_” and “-”, up to 64 characters; can't be renamed later.
profiles.editorLead: Empty fields use the global settings. Changes don't affect finished steps; reprocessing uses the new version.
profiles.saveBeforeDefault: Unsaved changes: save them before setting this preset as default.
profiles.savedConcurrent: Saved, but another change was written at the same time; it's now v{{version}}. Check that the settings are what you expect.
profiles.invalid_one: {{count}} field is invalid, so nothing was saved. Fix the marked field and save again.
profiles.invalid_other: {{count}} fields are invalid, so nothing was saved. Fix the marked fields and save again.
profiles.conflictBody: You started editing {{name}} at v{{mine}}, but it's now v{{theirs}}. Reloading discards your changes; saving anyway writes the fields you changed on top of v{{theirs}} and keeps the rest.
profiles.stageInheritNote: This step uses the global settings. Choose how it runs to save it in the preset.

field.promptVersionHint: Follow default: when a new version is set as default, the next run uses it.
field.minSimilarityHint: 0 to 1; corrections less similar than this fall back to the original. Leave empty to use the global setting.
field.targetsHint: BCP-47 tags separated by commas, e.g. zh-Hant-TW, en. Leave empty to use the global setting.
field.variantStrategy: When Chinese differs only in script
field.pathHint: An absolute path on the server.

splitTiming.when_needed: Only when needed, at pauses first

profiles.outputsEmpty: No outputs: subtitle files won't be written after processing.

styles.lead: Choose or customize ASS styles. Built-in styles can't be changed; copy one to a custom style to adjust it.
styles.emptyCustom: No custom styles yet. Copy a built-in style, or import an .ass file.
styles.copyDescription: Creates a new custom style from this style's settings.
styles.nameRule: Lowercase letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, up to 64 characters; can't match a built-in name.
styles.importDescription: Reads the styles from an .ass or .ssa file and creates a custom style. Only styles are read, not the subtitle lines.
styles.importPrimaryHint: Defaults to the next style in the file; with only one style, it's a smaller copy of the translation line.
styles.importTranslationHint: Defaults to Default, or the first style.
styles.builtinReadOnly: Built-in styles can't be changed. Copy it to a custom style to adjust it.
styles.targetLangHint: Without a set font, a default font is used for the language; the preview uses this translation.

field.fontHint: Leave empty to choose automatically by language.

translationAt.top: Translation at the top of the screen

styles.previewChooseItem: Choose media and a time to see the style on a real frame.
styles.previewFixFields: Fix the marked fields to update the preview.
styles.previewAtHint: MM:SS or HH:MM:SS; also picks the line shown.
